claim: Hibernation needs an instance family that supports hibernation, and bare metal instances are not supported; the supported list covers general purpose families (including T2, T3, T3a, T4g and T8i), compute optimized, memory optimized and storage optimized families. Hibernation works with instances in all AWS Regions.

evidence.quote: You must use an instance family that supports hibernation. However, bare metal instances are not supported.
You can use hibernation with instances in all AWS Regions.

General purpose: M3, M4, M5, M5a, M5ad, M5d, M6a, M6g, M6gd, M6i, M6id, M6idn, M6in, M7a, M7g, M7gd, M7i, M7i-flex, M8a, M8azn, M8g, M8gb, M8gd, M8gn, M8i, M8i-flex, M8in, M8idn, M8ib, M8idb, M9g, M9gd, T2, T3, T3a, T4g, T8i
Compute optimized: C3, C4, C5, C5d, C6a, C6g, C6gd, C6gn, C6i, C6id, C6in, C7a, C7g, C7gd, C7gn, C7i, C7i-flex, C8a, C8g, C8gb, C8gd, C8gn, C8i, C8i-flex, C8in, C8ib, C9g, C9gd
